body.id: Gandhi memimpin perlawanan tanpa kekerasan di India. Mandela, setelah 27 tahun dipenjara, memilih perundingan dan rekonsiliasi untuk mengakhiri apartheid.
body.en: Gandhi led non-violent resistance in India. Mandela, after 27 years in prison, chose negotiation and reconciliation to end apartheid.

body.id: Di unit ini Anda membaca sumber pendek dan melihat bahwa sejarah sering lebih rumit daripada satu julukan.
body.en: In this unit you will read short sources and see that history is often more complex than a single label.

body.id: Raja Sejong membuat huruf yang mudah dipelajari rakyat Korea. Louis Braille membuat tulisan yang bisa dibaca dengan ujung jari.
body.en: King Sejong created letters that ordinary Koreans could learn easily. Louis Braille created writing that can be read with a fingertip.

body.id: Kisah ketiga, Cut Nyak Dhien, menunjukkan kepemimpinan dan kepedulian hingga akhir hayatnya, termasuk mengajar warga di tempat pengasingannya.
body.en: The third story, Cut Nyak Dhien, shows leadership and care to the end of her life, including teaching local people in exile.

body.id: Pada masa itu, pemerintah kolonial Inggris menguasai pembuatan dan penjualan garam di India, dan memperoleh banyak pemasukan darinya.
body.en: At the time the British colonial government controlled the making and selling of salt in India and earned a large income from it.

body.id: Hukum melarang orang India membuat atau menjual garam sendiri. Garam yang dikenai pajak itu mahal, dan pajaknya sangat memberatkan rakyat termiskin.
body.en: The law barred Indians from making or selling their own salt. The taxed salt was expensive, and the tax hit the poorest people hardest.

body.id: Semua orang membutuhkan garam, sehingga mengambil garam di pantai menjadi tanda protes yang dipahami semua orang (diringkas).
body.en: Everyone needs salt, so picking it up on the shore was a protest everyone could understand (summarised).

body.id: Komite Nobel memberikan Hadiah Nobel Perdamaian 1993 kepada Nelson Mandela dan F.W. de Klerk «atas kerja mereka untuk mengakhiri rezim apartheid secara damai, dan untuk meletakkan dasar bagi Afrika Selatan baru yang demokratis» (terjemahan bebas).
body.en: The Nobel Committee gave the 1993 Peace Prize to Nelson Mandela and F.W. de Klerk "for their work for the peaceful termination of the apartheid regime, and for laying the foundations for a new democratic South Africa."

body.id: Mandela tidak selalu memilih cara tanpa kekerasan: sebelum ditangkap, ia ikut memimpin sayap bersenjata gerakannya. Hadiah 1993 diberikan untuk peralihan damai yang ia rundingkan setelah bebas.
body.en: Mandela did not always choose non-violence: before his arrest he helped lead his movement's armed wing. The 1993 prize honoured the peaceful transition he negotiated after his release.

body.en: Source: nobelprize.org, Nelson Mandela – Facts and Speed read (1993).

body.en: In the preface of the Hunminjeongeum (1446), King Sejong explained his reasons, roughly like this:

body.id: Bahasa negeri ini berbeda dari bahasa Tiongkok, sehingga tidak cocok ditulis dengan aksaranya. Karena itu banyak rakyat biasa tidak dapat menuliskan apa yang ingin mereka sampaikan.
body.en: The speech of this country differs from Chinese and does not fit its characters. So many ordinary people cannot put into writing what they want to say.

body.id: Ia lalu membuat 28 huruf baru, agar setiap orang mudah mempelajarinya dan memakainya sehari-hari (diringkas, bukan kutipan langsung).
body.en: So he made 28 new letters, so that everyone could learn them easily and use them every day (summarised, not a direct quotation).

body.en: In November 2018 the UN General Assembly proclaimed 4 January as World Braille Day (resolution A/RES/73/161).

body.en: According to the UN, the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities sees braille as essential for education, freedom of expression, access to information and social inclusion (summarised).

ST-A-GANDHI.source: Britannica: Salt March; Britannica Kids: Salt March; History.com: Gandhi's first act of civil disobedience (7 June 1893); PBB (UN Indonesia): International Day of Non-Violence, A/RES/61/271

caption.id: Mohandas Gandhi lahir di Porbandar, India, pada 2 Oktober 1869. Ia belajar hukum di London dan menjadi pengacara.
caption.en: Mohandas Gandhi was born in Porbandar, India, on 2 October 1869. He studied law in London and became a lawyer.

caption.id: Pada 1893 ia bekerja di Afrika Selatan. Di sana ia dipaksa turun dari gerbong kelas satu kereta api karena warna kulitnya.
caption.en: In 1893 he went to work in South Africa. There he was forced off a first-class train carriage because of the colour of his skin.

caption.id: Gandhi memilih melawan ketidakadilan tanpa kekerasan. Ia menyebut caranya satyagraha, yang berarti berpegang teguh pada kebenaran.
caption.en: Gandhi chose to resist injustice without violence. He called his method satyagraha, meaning holding firmly to truth.

caption.id: Kembali di India, ia mengajak rakyat memintal benang dan menenun kain sendiri. Roda pintal menjadi lambang kemandirian.
caption.en: Back in India, he urged people to spin thread and weave their own cloth. The spinning wheel became a symbol of self-reliance.

caption.id: Pada 12 Maret 1930 ia memulai Pawai Garam, berjalan kaki sekitar 385 km ke pantai Dandi. Di sana, pada 6 April, ia mengambil segenggam garam sebagai protes damai terhadap pajak garam.
caption.en: On 12 March 1930 he began the Salt March, walking about 385 km to the coast at Dandi. There, on 6 April, he picked up a handful of salt in peaceful protest against the salt tax.

caption.id: India merdeka pada 1947, dan Gandhi wafat pada 30 Januari 1948. Hari lahirnya, 2 Oktober, kini diperingati PBB sebagai Hari Internasional Tanpa Kekerasan.
caption.en: India became independent in 1947, and Gandhi died on 30 January 1948. His birthday, 2 October, is now marked by the UN as the International Day of Non-Violence.

title.en: Mandela and the road to reconciliation

ST-A-MANDELA.source: nobelprize.org: Nelson Mandela – Speed read (Peace 1993); UN General Assembly A/RES/64/13: Nelson Mandela International Day

caption.id: Nelson Mandela lahir di Mvezo, Afrika Selatan, pada 18 Juli 1918. Ia kemudian menjadi pengacara di Johannesburg.
caption.en: Nelson Mandela was born in Mvezo, South Africa, on 18 July 1918. He later became a lawyer in Johannesburg.

caption.id: Saat itu Afrika Selatan menjalankan apartheid, hukum yang memisahkan dan membeda-bedakan warga berdasarkan ras. Mandela menjadi salah satu pemimpin gerakan yang menentangnya.
caption.en: South Africa then had apartheid, laws that separated people and treated them unequally by race. Mandela became one of the leaders of the movement against it.

caption.id: Ia dipenjara dari 1962 hingga 1990, selama 27 tahun. Di penjara ia tetap belajar dan menjaga harapan.
caption.en: He was in prison from 1962 to 1990, 27 years in all. In prison he kept studying and kept hope alive.

caption.id: Ia dibebaskan pada 11 Februari 1990. Ia memilih jalan perundingan dan rekonsiliasi, bukan balas dendam.
caption.en: He was freed on 11 February 1990. He chose negotiation and reconciliation, not revenge.

caption.id: Pada 1993 ia menerima Nobel Perdamaian bersama F.W. de Klerk atas upaya mengakhiri apartheid secara damai. Pada 1994 ia menjadi presiden pertama Afrika Selatan yang dipilih secara demokratis oleh seluruh warga.
caption.en: In 1993 he shared the Nobel Peace Prize with F.W. de Klerk for working to end apartheid peacefully. In 1994 he became South Africa's first president elected democratically by all its citizens.

caption.id: Mandela wafat pada 5 Desember 2013; hari lahirnya, 18 Juli, diperingati sebagai Hari Nelson Mandela Internasional. Kisahnya mengajak kita memilih dialog dan berani memaafkan.
caption.en: Mandela died on 5 December 2013; his birthday, 18 July, is marked as Nelson Mandela International Day. His story asks us to choose dialogue and have the courage to forgive.

ST-A-SEJONG.figure: Raja Sejong Agung / King Sejong the Great (1397–1450)

title.en: King Sejong and the Hangul alphabet

ST-A-SEJONG.source: UNESCO Memory of the World: Hunmin Chongum (nomination file); World History Encyclopedia: Sejong the Great; Korea JoongAng Daily: This week in history (rain gauge)

caption.id: Sejong menjadi raja keempat Dinasti Joseon di Korea pada 1418 dan memerintah hingga 1450. Pada 1420 ia mendirikan Jiphyeonjeon, «Balai Para Cendekia».
caption.en: Sejong became the fourth king of Korea's Joseon dynasty in 1418 and reigned until 1450. In 1420 he founded the Jiphyeonjeon, the "Hall of Worthies", for scholars.

caption.id: Saat itu orang Korea menulis dengan aksara Tionghoa yang rumit dan butuh bertahun-tahun untuk dikuasai. Kebanyakan rakyat biasa tidak bisa menuliskan pikirannya.
caption.en: At the time Koreans wrote with Chinese characters, which took years to master. Most ordinary people could not put their thoughts into writing.

caption.id: Sejong merancang aksara baru yang sederhana. Pada 1443 ia menyelesaikan 28 huruf: 17 konsonan dan 11 vokal.
caption.en: Sejong designed a simple new script. In 1443 he completed 28 letters: 17 consonants and 11 vowels.

caption.id: Sebagian pejabat menolak aksara baru itu. Sejong tetap melanjutkan, dan pada 1446 aksara itu diumumkan dalam buku Hunminjeongeum, «Bunyi yang Benar untuk Mengajar Rakyat».
caption.en: Some officials opposed the new script. Sejong carried on, and in 1446 it was proclaimed in the book Hunminjeongeum, "The Correct Sounds for the Instruction of the People".

caption.id: Pada masa Sejong juga dibuat alat pengukur hujan yang seragam. Dengan alat itu, curah hujan di berbagai daerah bisa dicatat untuk pertanian.
caption.en: Sejong's reign also produced a standard rain gauge. With it, rainfall across the kingdom could be recorded for farming.

caption.id: Kini aksara itu disebut Hangul dan dipakai jutaan orang; buku Hunminjeongeum tercatat dalam daftar Ingatan Dunia UNESCO. Kisahnya mengajak kita membuat ilmu mudah dijangkau semua orang.
caption.en: Today the script is called Hangul and used by millions; the Hunminjeongeum book is on UNESCO's Memory of the World register. His story asks us to make knowledge easy for everyone to reach.

title.en: Louis Braille and the six dots

ST-A-BRAILLE.source: Britannica: Louis Braille; un.org: World Braille Day – Background (A/RES/73/161)

caption.id: Louis Braille lahir di Coupvray, Prancis, pada 4 Januari 1809. Ayahnya membuat perlengkapan kuda dari kulit.
caption.en: Louis Braille was born in Coupvray, France, on 4 January 1809. His father made leather harness for horses.

caption.id: Pada usia tiga tahun, ia mengalami kecelakaan di bengkel ayahnya. Tak lama kemudian kedua matanya tidak dapat melihat lagi.
caption.en: At the age of three he had an accident in his father's workshop. Soon afterwards he lost the sight of both eyes.

caption.id: Pada 1819, dengan beasiswa, ia masuk sekolah anak tunanetra di Paris. Buku untuk pembaca tunanetra saat itu memakai huruf timbul yang besar, berat, dan lambat dibaca.
caption.en: In 1819, on a scholarship, he entered the school for blind children in Paris. Books for blind readers then used large raised letters that were heavy and slow to read.

caption.id: Charles Barbier, seorang mantan perwira, memperkenalkan tulisan titik timbul di sekolah itu. Louis menyederhanakannya menjadi sel enam titik yang muat di bawah satu ujung jari.
caption.en: Charles Barbier, a former army officer, showed the school a writing system of raised dots. Louis simplified it into a cell of six dots that fits under one fingertip.

caption.id: Sejak 1826 ia mengajar di sekolah itu, dan pada 1829, di usia 20 tahun, ia menerbitkan caranya. Ia juga menyesuaikan sistemnya untuk menulis musik.
caption.en: From 1826 he taught at the school, and in 1829, aged 20, he published his method. He also adapted the system for writing music.

caption.id: Louis Braille wafat pada 1852, dan kini braille dipakai di seluruh dunia; 4 Januari diperingati sebagai Hari Braille Sedunia. Kisahnya mengajak kita merancang hal-hal yang bisa dipakai semua orang.
caption.en: Louis Braille died in 1852, and today braille is used all over the world; 4 January is World Braille Day. His story asks us to design things everyone can use.

title.id: Cut Nyak Dhien: memimpin dan peduli
title.en: Cut Nyak Dhien: leading and caring

ST-A-CUT-NYAK-DHIEN.source: Keppres No. 106 Tahun 1964; Metro TV News: #OnThisDay Mengenang wafatnya Cut Nyak Dhien; detikEdu (2024): Cut Nyak Dien, putri bangsawan yang jadi Pahlawan Nasional; UIN Sunan Kalijaga (digilib 38063): Pengasingan Cut Nyak Dhien di Sumedang tahun 1906–1908

caption.id: Cut Nyak Dhien lahir pada 1848 di Lampadang, Aceh Besar, dalam keluarga bangsawan. Ia tumbuh dalam masyarakat yang taat beragama dan menjunjung adat.
caption.en: Cut Nyak Dhien was born in 1848 in Lampadang, Aceh Besar, into a noble family. She grew up in a community devoted to faith and custom.

caption.id: Sejak 1873, Aceh dilanda perang panjang melawan pemerintah kolonial Belanda. Banyak keluarga kehilangan rumah dan orang tercinta, termasuk Cut Nyak Dhien.
caption.en: From 1873 Aceh was caught in a long war with the Dutch colonial government. Many families lost homes and loved ones, Cut Nyak Dhien among them.

caption.id: Setelah suaminya, Teuku Umar, gugur pada 1899, ia sendiri memimpin rakyatnya. Ia menjaga kelompoknya tetap bersatu sambil berpindah-pindah di hutan dan pegunungan Aceh.
caption.en: After her husband Teuku Umar fell in 1899, she led her people herself. She kept her group together as they moved through the forests and mountains of Aceh.

caption.id: Bertahun-tahun di hutan membuatnya renta dan sakit: matanya rabun dan ia menderita encok. Pang Laot, pengikut setianya, iba melihat keadaannya dan pada 1905 memberitahukan tempatnya kepada Belanda.
caption.en: Years in the forest left her frail and ill, with failing eyes and painful joints. Pang Laot, her loyal follower, pitied her condition and in 1905 told the Dutch where she was.

caption.id: Ia diasingkan ke Sumedang, Jawa Barat. Di sana ia mengajarkan agama kepada warga sekitar, yang menyebutnya «Ibu Perbu».
caption.en: She was exiled to Sumedang in West Java. There she taught religion to the local people, who called her "Ibu Perbu".

caption.id: Cut Nyak Dhien wafat di Sumedang pada 6 November 1908 dan diangkat menjadi Pahlawan Nasional pada 1964. Kisahnya mengajak kita setia kepada sesama dan terus berbagi ilmu, bahkan di masa sulit.
caption.en: Cut Nyak Dhien died in Sumedang on 6 November 1908 and was named a National Hero in 1964. Her story asks us to stand by others and keep sharing knowledge, even in hard times.

items.source: Britannica: Louis Braille (six-dot cell; adapted for music); hitungan kombinatorik 2^6 − 1 = 63

model_answer.id: Enam titik dalam satu sel braille dapat disusun menjadi 63 pola berbeda (2 pangkat 6, dikurangi sel kosong). Cukup untuk huruf, angka, tanda baca, dan not musik.
model_answer.en: The six dots of a braille cell can form 63 different patterns (2 to the power of 6, minus the empty cell). That is enough for letters, numbers, punctuation and musical notes.

meaning.id: Pawai Garam dimulai pada 12 Maret 1930 dan tiba di Dandi pada 5 April. Berapa hari perjalanannya?
meaning.en: The Salt March began on 12 March 1930 and reached Dandi on 5 April. How many days did it take?

model_answer.id: Dari 12 Maret ke 31 Maret 19 hari, ditambah 5 hari di bulan April: 24 hari.
model_answer.en: 12 to 31 March is 19 days, plus 5 days in April: 24 days.
